name: church-network-app
description: Embrace Church Network: Express API (backend) and Next.js app (frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,api,web --prefix-colors yellow,blue,magenta "npm run -w @embrace/shared build -- --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run -w backend dev" "npm run -w frontend dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run -w backend build && npm run -w frontend build
